name: taking my Dark Knight Girlfriend to the corner store
source:
Dana is a mostly normal girl living a mostly normal life until one day, Brunhilde- a fearsome Dark Knight from another realm- tears through a portal in the sky and asks Dana to guide her to find and slay the mysterious Gray Wizard.

Instantly, Dana enlists herself as Brunhilde's companion and guide, promising to help her find her prize in this unfamiliar world - all while praying Brunhilde never catches onto the fact that Dana has no idea who she's looking for.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3789280/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
达纳（Dana）是一个几乎正常的女孩，过着几乎正常的生活，直到有一天，来自另一个领域的可怕黑暗骑士布伦希尔德（Brunhilde）撕裂了天空中的门户，并要求达纳引导她找到并杀死神秘的灰巫师。

达娜立即成为布伦希尔德的同伴和向导，承诺帮助她在这个陌生的世界找到她的奖品 - 同时祈祷布伦希尔德永远不会意识到达娜不知道她在寻找谁。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3789280/]Steam[/url]]
